name: git-github-mcp
description: FastMCP 3.1+ portmanteau server for Git (local) and GitHub (gh CLI). Two tools cover 86 actions, plus 6 prompts, 6 resources, and an agentic sampling workflow.

tools.name: git_ops
tools.description: Local Git operations — 43 actions: init, clone, add, commit, push, pull, fetch, status, log, diff, show, blame, branch_list/create/switch/delete/merge, rebase, remote_list/add/remove, stash/pop/list/drop, tag_list/create/delete, reset, revert, cherry_pick, clean, submodule_add/update/sync/status, bisect_start/bad/good/reset, worktree_add/list/remove

tools.name: github_ops
tools.description: GitHub operations via gh CLI — 43 actions: repo_list/view/create/fork/clone/delete/rename/archive, issue_list/view/create/close/comment, pr_list/view/create/merge/checkout/close/comment, release_list/view/create/delete/update, workflow_list/run/runs/cancel/disable/enable, label_list/create/delete, secrets_list/set/delete, collaborator_add/remove, search_repos/issues/code, auth_status, gist_list

tools.name: git_agentic_workflow
tools.description: Agentic multi-step Git/GitHub workflow using LLM sampling. Describe a task in natural language; the tool plans and executes the required git_ops/github_ops steps automatically.

tools.name: git_github_help
tools.description: Contextual help for all git-github-mcp tools (level: basic/intermediate/advanced, topic: git_ops/github_ops)

tools.name: git_github_status
tools.description: System status: git and gh CLI availability, versions, and auth state

prompts.name: git_commit_message
prompts.description: Generate a conventional commit message from a staged diff

prompts.name: git_release_notes
prompts.description: Generate release notes from a commit log

prompts.name: git_pr_description
prompts.description: Generate a pull request description from branch and commits

prompts.name: git_review_diff
prompts.description: Code review prompt for a git diff

prompts.name: github_issue_template
prompts.description: Generate a well-structured GitHub issue body (types: bug, feature, docs, question)

prompts.name: github_debug_workflow
prompts.description: Debug a failing GitHub Actions workflow from its error output

resources.description: Current git status of the working directory
Recent commit log of the working directory
Git status for a specific repo path
Commit log for a specific repo path
Open issues for a GitHub repository
Open pull requests for a GitHub repository

dependencies: gh CLI (gh auth login required for github_ops)
